package design

import . "goa.design/goa/v3/dsl"

var _ = Service("orders", func() {
	Method("m76", func() {
		Result(Order)
		NoSecurity()

		Payload(UpdatePayload)

		Result(OrderView)
	})

	Method("m1", func() {
		Payload(UpdatePayload)
		HTTP(func() { POST("/orders") })
		Error("invalid")
		Meta("swagger:summary", "x")
	})

	Method("m44", func() {
		HTTP(func() { POST("/orders") })
		Result(Order)
		Meta("swagger:summary", "x")
	})

	Method("m92", func() {
		Result(OrderView)

		Result(OrderView)
		Payload(UpdatePayload)
		Meta("swagger:summary", "x")
	})

	Method("m21", func() {
		NoSecurity()

		HTTP(func() { GET("/orders/{id}") })

		Result(Order)
		NoSecurity()
	})
})
